description: Search the GeoNames gazetteer of 13M+ places by name and filters: country, feature class (P populated places, A admin divisions, T mountains and terrain, H water, S buildings and spots), feature code (PPLC capitals, ADM1 states, MT mountains, AIRP airports), population tier, and bounding box. Results carry the geonameId that geonames_get_place, geonames_get_hierarchy, and geonames_get_children take. The default match requires a query term in the place name while letting other terms match the country or admin names ("Berlin, Germany"). Costs 1 GeoNames credit per call.

boundingBox.description: Keep only places inside this box. The box cannot cross the 180° meridian: split such an area into two searches.

east.description: Eastern longitude bound, decimal degrees, -180 to 180.

north.description: Northern latitude bound, decimal degrees, -90 to 90.

south.description: Southern latitude bound, decimal degrees, -90 to 90; below north.

west.description: Western longitude bound, decimal degrees, -180 to 180; below east.

cities.description: Keep only populated places (class P) with a population of at least 1,000 (cities1000), 5,000 (cities5000), or 15,000 (cities15000), plus seats of admin divisions: GeoNames' cities tiers. Beside featureClasses or featureCodes, list only class P or class-P codes such as PPLC. Case-insensitive.

countries.description: ISO 3166-1 country codes, up to 10, as a list or a comma-separated string: alpha-2 (US, GB, DE), alpha-3 (USA, GBR, DEU), or three-digit numeric (840, 826, 276), each sent to GeoNames as alpha-2. Case-insensitive; UK is accepted for GB.

items.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, alpha-3, or three-digit numeric country code.

featureClasses.description: GeoNames feature classes: A admin divisions, H water, L areas, P populated places, R roads, S spots and buildings, T terrain, U undersea, V vegetation. A list or a comma-separated string; case-insensitive. With featureCodes too, the two lists intersect: list exactly the classes of those codes, or pass featureCodes alone.

featureCodes.description: GeoNames feature codes (PPLC capital, ADM1 state, MT mountain, AIRP airport), up to 20, as a list or a comma-separated string. Case-insensitive; a class prefix (P.PPLC) is dropped. Each code implies its class; with featureClasses too, the two lists intersect, so featureClasses must list exactly these codes' classes. geonames_list_reference topic feature_codes lists every code.

items.description: GeoNames feature code without its class prefix.

geonamesUsername.description: Your own GeoNames username, so the call spends that account's free credits instead of the server's. Omit it to use the server's account. The account needs free web services enabled on its geonames.org account page.

limit.description: Maximum entries to return, 1 to 100. Default 10.

match.description: How query is matched. name_required (the default) needs at least one query term in the place name while other terms may match the country or admin names; any_field lets every term match any of those fields; exact_name matches the whole name exactly, alternate and historical names included; name_prefix matches names that start with query. Needs query. Case-insensitive.

offset.description: Entries to skip before the first one returned, for paging, 0 to 5000. Default 0.

orderBy.description: Result order: relevance (GeoNames' default) or population, largest first. Case-insensitive.

query.description: Place name to search for, such as Springfield or "Berlin, Germany", up to 200 characters. match sets how it is compared. Omit it to search by filters alone, which then needs at least one of countries, featureClasses, featureCodes, or boundingBox (cities alone is not enough).

name: geonames_search_places

effectiveQuery.description: The match mode, query, and filters as the server sent them to GeoNames.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `query_or_filter_required`: Neither query nor a narrowing filter (countries, featureClasses, featureCodes, boundingBox) was given. `query_required`: match was set without query. `unknown_country_code`: A countries entry is a well-formed alpha-3 or three-digit numeric code that no country has. `unknown_feature_code`: A featureCodes entry is not a GeoNames feature code. `feature_filter_mismatch`: featureClasses and featureCodes are both set and a code's class is not listed or a listed class has no listed code, or cities (class P only) is set beside another class or a code outside class P. GeoNames intersects the filters, so those entries match nothing. `invalid_bounding_box`: boundingBox has south greater than or equal to north, or west greater than or equal to east. `username_required`: Neither geonamesUsername nor the server's GEONAMES_USERNAME supplies a GeoNames account. `caller_account_rejected`: GeoNames rejected the caller-supplied geonamesUsername (unknown user, or free web services not enabled). `server_account_rejected`: GeoNames rejected the server's GEONAMES_USERNAME. `quota_exhausted`: GeoNames reported the account's hourly, daily, or weekly credit limit spent, or this server's pacer for the account shed the call. `upstream_rejected_parameter`: GeoNames rejected a value the schema let through; the message carries its text. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

nextOffset.description: Offset of the next page; absent on the last page and once offset is 5000. Capped at 5000, the last offset GeoNames' free service accepts, so that page can repeat rows of this one.

notice.description: Guidance when nothing matched or more pages remain.

places.description: Places on this page, in the requested order.

adminCode1.description: Code of the first-order admin division (state, province) containing it.

adminName1.description: Name of the first-order admin division containing it.

countryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the containing country.

featureClass.description: One-letter feature class (P populated place, A admin division, …).

featureCode.description: Feature code, such as PPLC (capital) or ADM1 (first-order division).

featureName.description: GeoNames' name for the feature code.

geonameId.description: GeoNames feature id: pass it to geonames_get_place, geonames_get_hierarchy, or geonames_get_children.

iso3166_2.description: ISO 3166-2 code of the first-order admin division, subdivision part only: MO, not US-MO.

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees. Absent when GeoNames sent none.

lng.description: Longitude in decimal degrees. Absent when GeoNames sent none.

name.description: Name of the place, as GeoNames displays it.

population.description: Population. Absent when GeoNames records none.

toponymName.description: GeoNames' main name for the feature, often the local-language form.

totalCount.description: GeoNames' count of matching places, before paging.

truncated.description: True when more matching places remain past this page.

title: Search GeoNames places
